item.title: 'Solution in search of a problem': Judge bars Trump admin from detaining thousands of Minnesota immigrants admitted as refugees
item.description: The Trump administration may not detain thousands of immigrants in Minnesota who were admitted into the country but have not yet received lawful permanent resident status, a federal judge ruled.
